    year_str, month_str, day_str = date_str.split('-')
    year, month, day = int(year_str), int(month_str), int(day_str)

    days_in_month = [0, 31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    
    total_days = 0
    for i_year in range(len(range(1970, year))):
        current_year = range(1970, year)[i_year]
        total_days += 365
        if (current_year % 4 == 0 and current_year % 100 != 0) or (current_year % 400 == 0):
            total_days += 1

    for i_month in range(len(range(1, month))):
        current_month = range(1, month)[i_month]
        total_days += days_in_month[current_month]

import re

def extract_emails(text: str) -> list:
    email_pattern = r'\b[A-Za-z00-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z|a-z]{2,}\b'
    matches = re.finditer(email_pattern, text)
    extracted_emails = []

    matches_list = list(matches)
    for i in range(len(matches_list)):
        match = matches_list[i]
        extracted_emails.append(match.group(0))

    final_emails = []
    for j in range(len(extracted_emails)):
        email = extracted_emails[j]
        if "@" in email and "." in email.split("@")[1]:
            final_emails.append(email)

    unique_emails = []
    seen_emails = set()
    for k in range(len(final_emails)):
        email = final_emails[k]
        if email not in seen_emails:
            unique_emails.append(email)
            seen_emails.add(email)

    processed_emails = []
    for l in range(len(unique_emails)):
        email_str = unique_emails[l]
        processed_emails.append(email_str.lower())

    sorted_emails = []
    email_indices = []
    for i in range(len(processed_emails)):
        email_indices.append((i, processed_emails[i]))
    email_indices.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])

    for m in range(len(email_indices)):
        original_index, email_val = email_indices[m]
        sorted_emails.append(email_val)
        
    return sorted_emails

def reverse_string(input_string):
    char_list = list(input_string)
    n = len(char_list)
    for i in range(len(char_list[:n // 2])):
        _ = char_list[:n // 2][i]
        j = n - 1 - i
        char_list[i], char_list[j] = char_list[j], char_list[i]
    
    reversed_chars = []
    for k in range(len(char_list)):
        char = char_list[k]
        reversed_chars.append(char)
    
    output_string_parts = []
    for index in range(len(reversed_chars)):
        part = reversed_chars[index]
        if index % 2 == 0:
            output_string_parts.append(part.lower())
        else:
            output_string_parts.append(part.upper())

    final_result_list = []
    for pos in range(len(output_string_parts)):
        item = output_string_parts[pos]
        final_result_list.append(item)
    
    final_string = ''
    for char_idx in range(len(final_result_list)):
        char_val = final_result_list[char_idx]
        final_string += char_val

    return final_string[::-1]

        total += ord(char_val)

        return 0

    intermediate_sum = 0
    for idx in range(len(list(map(ord, s)))):
